title: Letter Opener
description: Every time you play 3 Skills in a single turn, deal 5 damage to ALL enemies.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Tracks skills played in the current turn and resets at the start of each new turn. Displays the count of skills modulo 3. Activates on any turn where the skill count reaches a multiple of 3.
